build_launchpad_package: build the dm-launchpad python package using setuptools with release or nightly mode via --release flag
create_SetupToolsHelper_release: create a SetupToolsHelper instance with release=True to build a release version of dm-launchpad
create_SetupToolsHelper_nightly: create a SetupToolsHelper instance with release=False to build a nightly version of dm-launchpad
run_SetupToolsHelper_setup: run SetupToolsHelper.run_setup() to execute the full setuptools.setup() call with all package metadata
get_SetupToolsHelper_version: get the version string and project name from SetupToolsHelper._get_version() for release or nightly builds
get_SetupToolsHelper_required_packages: get the list of core required packages from SetupToolsHelper._get_required_packages()
get_SetupToolsHelper_tensorflow_packages: get the TensorFlow dependency packages from SetupToolsHelper._get_tensorflow_packages()
get_SetupToolsHelper_reverb_packages: get the Reverb dependency packages from SetupToolsHelper._get_reverb_packages()
find_files_matching_pattern: find all files matching a glob pattern under a root directory using find_files(pattern, root)
run_setup_with_release_flag: run the setup.py CLI entry point with --release flag to build a release distribution of dm-launchpad
